examples.title: enableHapticFeedback18+
examples.description:
enableHapticFeedback(enable: Optional<boolean>)
Sets whether to enable haptic feedback.
Atomic service API: This API can be used in atomic services since API version 18.
System capability: SystemCapability.ArkUI.ArkUI.Full
Parameters
Whether to enable haptic feedback.
- true: Enable haptic feedback.
- false: Disable haptic feedback.
Default value: true.
Whether this parameter takes effect after being set to true depends on hardware support.
If the value of enable is undefined, the default value is used.

examples.title: Example 1: Switching Between Gregorian and Lunar Calendars
examples.description: This example implements a date picker that allows users to switch between the Gregorian (solar) calendar and the lunar calendar by clicking a button.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Text Style
examples.description: This example shows how to customize the text style using disappearTextStyle, textStyle, and selectedTextStyle.

examples.title: Example 3: Displaying Year and Month, or Month and Day Columns
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to display year and month, or month and day columns using mode.
The mode attribute of DatePickerOptions is added since API version 18.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting Loop Scrolling
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set whether to enable loop scrolling using canLoop, available since API version 20.
